dct_description_sm: These files are the raw data from a study that evaluate the microplastics content of soil from agricultural fields in Ontario that have and have not been amended with biosolids. The raw data is associated with the article "Comparing the microplastic content in biosolid-amended and non-amended agricultural soils".
dct_title_s: Supplemental data for: Comparative analysis of microplastic content and deposition in biosolid-amended and non-amended agricultural soils in southern Ontario, Canada
